text: A status table with coloured emoji and a written diagnosis flags the breach clearly; it is a report, not a dashboard, and cannot be sorted or re-thresholded.
a2ui: Summary cards, bound service cards with status icons and an Investigate button per service work well; there is no colour for severity and no gauges or sorting.
html: A dark ops dashboard: stat tiles, sortable columns, gauges with an SLO tick and threshold sliders that re-evaluate which services breach as you drag.
agui: This is the approach's best case: a human-in-the-loop decision (service, action, severity, who to notify) with rules that reveal fields, returned as a typed tool result.
